g.title: crate shadcn/ui Lyra-styled components on the public Kivact facade.
crate::alert Basic visual variants and recipes for standard alert callouts.
crate::alert_dialog The width class of an alert dialog, which the kit's dialog recipes read.
crate::attachment The Lyra attachment: a file chip with media, text, state and actions.
crate::avatar Lyra avatar, image clipping and facepile member recipes.
crate::badge Basic visual badge variants and their recipe.
crate::breadcrumb Lyra recipes for the canonical keyed breadcrumb trail.
crate::button The Lyra button looks shared by recipes, triggers and kit components.
crate::card Basic visual card size variants and canonical card slot recipes.
crate::card_header The Lyra card header content: a title, a description and an action.
crate::chart The Lyra chart: bar, line, area, pie, radar and radial charts on a canvas.
crate::chart::cartesian Paint and hit-test the bar, stacked bar, line and area charts.
crate::chart::model The public chart data types and the frame the kinds paint and hit-test.
crate::chart::pie Paint and hit-test the pie, donut and radial charts.
crate::chart::plot Chart options, and painting and hit-testing dispatched by chart kind.
crate::chart::polar Angle helpers shared by the pie, radial and radar charts.
crate::chart::radar Paint and hit-test the radar chart.
crate::chart::scale Value scales and nice ticks of the chart kinds.
crate::chart::scale::tests Tests for the value domains of the charts.
crate::chart::tooltip The hover tooltip card and the legend of a chart.
crate::chart::view The Chart builder and its canvas, tooltip, legend and accessible text.
crate::chat Basic message and standalone bubble recipes for the canonical chat message.
crate::chat_colors Basic chat color variants, independent of message interaction.
crate::choice Toggle group built on the toggle and list interactions, and the toggle look.
crate::code_block Pure source-highlighting data and Basic code presentation variants.
crate::code_block::highlight Map pretokenized syntax spans to the current theme palette.
crate::code_block::lines The highlighted lines a code block shows: tones, spans and lines.
crate::code_block::rust A small Rust tokenizer that turns source text into highlighted code lines.
crate::code_block::view Basic code-size variants and recipes for the Core source editor.
crate::color The basic kit's own colors as values a style or a draw call accepts.
crate::date_picker Basic visual treatment of standard date picker surfaces.
crate::disclosure Basic visual variants for standard disclosures.
crate::drawer Basic visual variants for standard edge dialogs.
crate::empty Basic empty-state media variants and recipes.
crate::field Field-set, grouping and separator layouts of field.tsx.
crate::icons Embedded Lucide icons (ISC), which the kit's theme puts in its icon set.
crate::input_group Basic adornment, frame and borderless-control variants for input groups.
crate::input_otp One-time-code input: slots drawn over one hidden native text edit.
crate::item Basic item-row visual variants and canonical list recipes.
crate::layers Shared looks of the overlays: scrim, close button box and text styles.
crate::line_tabs The Lyra `line` variant of the standard tabs, given with `.variant(..)`.
crate::list_popup The popup list look and list shared by selects, menus and comboboxes.
crate::marker The Lyra marker: a muted inline note with optional rules and icon.
crate::menubar The Lyra menu bar: triggers of standard menus that move an open menu.
crate::message_scroller Basic recipes for the canonical follow-end chat thread and its real parts.
crate::native_select Native-select look on the select interaction: bordered trigger and chevron.
crate::navigation_menu Lyra appearance for the canonical navigation menu and its actual links.
crate::nice The round tick step shared by charts and plots.
crate::nice::tests Tests for the round tick step.
crate::pagination Lyra recipes for canonical pagination cells and the actual page binding.
crate::parts Shared parts of display components: pressable surfaces and resized icons.
crate::plot XY plots: the data model, the zoomable plot and its painting and readouts.
crate::plot::axis Axes: the title, the scale and the tick format of one axis.
crate::plot::axis::tests Tests for the axis builder.
crate::plot::data The numeric arrays a plot draws, shared by reference.
crate::plot::data::tests Tests for the equality, the conversions and the debug text of plot data.
crate::plot::decimate Splits a line into runs and keeps one min and max per pixel column.
crate::plot::decimate::tests Tests for line runs and min and max thinning.
crate::plot::heatmap Heatmap painting: the cell of each pixel, and its color on the colormap.
crate::plot::heatmap::tests Tests for heatmap cells, grid shapes and their colors.
crate::plot::input Zoom, pan, key and readout arithmetic of a plot, free of signals.
crate::plot::input::tests Tests for zoom, pan, keys and readout arithmetic.
crate::plot::model The plot model: axes, series and legend, and the range they fit.
crate::plot::model::tests Tests for the automatic view range and the range of a model.
crate::plot::paint Paints a plot: grid, axes, labels, series, legend and readout.
crate::plot::paint::tests Tests for the legend's name fitting.
crate::plot::scale Plot area and axis mapping between data values and pixels.
crate::plot::scale::tests Tests for the plot area and axis mapping.
crate::plot::series Series: what a plot draws, its data, color, line style and heatmap range.
crate::plot::series::tests Tests for the series defaults and the setters.
crate::plot::ticks Tick positions and the label format of plot axes and readouts.
crate::plot::ticks::tests Tests for tick positions and label formats.
crate::plot::view The Plot builder: a canvas whose range the pointer and keys edit.
crate::plot::view::tests Tests for the accessible description arguments.
crate::primitives Small Lyra primitives: label, separators, key groups, captions, crumb ellipsis.
crate::questionnaire Step-by-step questionnaire with choices or text input and progress.
crate::recipes Lyra recipes for the standard button, toggles and text fields.
crate::recipes_calendar Lyra calendar panels, day cells and range-band recipes.
crate::recipes_collections Lyra recipes for the standard list and data table.
crate::recipes_combobox Lyra field, suggestion and chip recipes for the standard combobox.
crate::recipes_command Lyra recipes for the standard command palette (command.tsx).
crate::recipes_controls Lyra recipes for the radio group, slider, toasts, splitter, toggle and more.
crate::recipes_dialog Lyra recipes for the standard dialog: dialog, alert dialog, sheet and popover.
crate::recipes_field Theme appearance for standard field labels, hints and errors.
crate::recipes_groups Lyra toggle and joined button group recipes.
crate::recipes_menu Lyra recipes for the standard menu: dropdown, use_context and menu bar looks.
crate::recipes_metrics Lyra circular and segmented progress recipes.
crate::recipes_popup Lyra recipes for select, menu, tooltip and tabs parts.
crate::scroll_area The Lyra scroll area: a scroll container with a slim border-colored bar.
crate::sidebar The Lyra sidebar: provider, panel, rail, trigger and menu parts.
crate::sidebar::menu The sidebar's groups, menu buttons, sub-menus, input, separator and skeleton.
crate::sidebar::panel The sidebar panel, its rail, the page beside it and the provider.
crate::sidebar::state The sidebar's shared enums and the use_context the provider gives its parts.
crate::sidebar::trigger The sidebar trigger button that toggles the provider's sidebar.
crate::table Lyra recipes for canonical static table sections and cells.
crate::theme Install the Lyra Neutral palette and complete standard component recipes.
crate::theme_access Shared Lyra style fragments and Lucide strokes for recipes and parts.
crate::tokens Public Lyra Neutral color tokens read by every component style.
crate::trace The Lyra trace: muted activity lines with a collapsible detail.
crate::typography shadcn/ui typography styles for headings, prose, quotes, code and lists.
